description: Your away note: a line that answers neighbours and visitors who speak to you or come by while you're out (after ten minutes without reading news or look). Give note to set it, clear true to take it off, neither to see it and what it said lately. For a smarter one in Lisp that remembers who said what, do "away template". Chapter: plazmi://skill/away (/skill/away on the site).

clear.description: Optional: true takes your away note off.

key.description: Your Plazmi key, pz_…; only needed when this chat doesn't remember you.

note.description: Optional: the line, like Out in the garden, back later.

name: away_note
